name: It's Time
source:
When Inspector Lucy Jenkins dies during a police encounter, John is determined to create a time portal to bring his wife back. While he succeeds and happens to warn his love about her upcoming danger, things get difficult for him. His time travel brings chaos to the world, as his friends and hometown get affected. John needs to make decisions to save his friends and family, but can he save them all?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1992930/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
警探露西·詹金斯在一次警方行动中丧生后，约翰决心造出时间传送门，救回自己的妻子。他成功了，也向爱人警告了即将来临的危险，事情却变得更加棘手。他的时间旅行给世界带来混乱，朋友与家乡都受到波及。约翰必须作出抉择，拯救亲友，可他真能救下所有人吗？

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1992930/]Steam[/url]]
